title: Page Content Sections

fields.label: Content Sections
fields.name: content_sections
fields.instructions: Add, remove, and reorder content sections. Every layout here is reusable on any page — this replaces page-specific/locked section fields and hardcoded page templates.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap a word in curly braces, e.g. {Firearm}, to render it in the accent color.

sub_fields.label: Heading Accent Line (optional)
sub_fields.name: heading_accent
sub_fields.instructions: If set, renders as a second accent-colored line below the heading.

sub_fields.label: Background Video (optional)
sub_fields.name: video
sub_fields.instructions: Self-hosted video file (mp4). If set, this plays muted/looped in place of the Image above; Image is used as a fallback/poster when no video is set.

sub_fields.label: CTA Button Text (optional)
sub_fields.name: tile_cta_text
sub_fields.instructions: If set, renders a visible button with this label linking to Link above. If blank, the whole card stays clickable with no visible button label (previous behavior).

sub_fields.label: Products
sub_fields.name: product_ids
sub_fields.instructions: Select up to 6 products. Leave empty to show 3 most recent published products.

sub_fields.label: Video ID
sub_fields.name: video_id
sub_fields.instructions: The YouTube/Vimeo video ID (not the full URL).

sub_fields.label: Embed Code
sub_fields.name: video_embed
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the full <iframe> embed code from Vimeo/YouTube.

sub_fields.label: Fallback CTA Label (optional)
sub_fields.name: cta_label
sub_fields.instructions: Shown only if no SDS files are added.

sub_fields.label: Gravity Form ID
sub_fields.name: gravity_form_id
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the numeric ID of the Gravity Form to display on this page.

sub_fields.label: Make entire column clickable (optional)
sub_fields.name: full_link
sub_fields.instructions: If enabled, the whole column links to the CTA URL above (in addition to the visible button). If disabled, only the button itself is clickable.

description: Universal, reusable content-section builder available on every Page. Add any layout, in any order, on any page instead of being locked to a specific template.
